post_clip.description: A person near the rear of the dark SUV (left side) suddenly drops/collapses to the ground between 00:00:04 and 00:00:05 without visible physical contact or tripping—consistent with a shooting incident. The individual remains on the ground thereafter while another person stands nearby; no other movement or reaction is visible in the limited field of view, but the sudden collapse without apparent cause is highly suspicious.

At timestamp 10:55:36, a person standing near the rear of the gray car suddenly drops/collapses to the ground without any visible physical contact or fall from height—consistent with being shot. Simultaneously, another individual near the black car reacts and begins moving away rapidly. The abrupt, unexplained collapse and immediate reactive movement strongly suggest gunfire.
